reasons: 화풍: 윤곽이 근흑(재질 어두운 톤 아님) (4/4)

surfaces.part: header panel (grey/white gradient with red stripe)
tan lane face with painted bowling pins

answer.evidence: The object is a flat, front-facing panel 16 px wide and about 45 rows tall. Rows 1-4 are a vertical light-to-white gradient, row 5 is dark, row 6 is a red stripe and rows 7-8 are dark. That is a header drawn face-on, with no front-edge line, no eave shadow and no ellipse. Rows 9-44 are a uniform tan face with pins painted flat on it, and no contents are visible inside an open container. No part of the main body shows a horizontal surface. The width stays at 16 from row 1 to row 44, so there is no widening or narrowing that would suggest an ellipse or a receding side. The reference cabinet that is judged RIGHT shows a top band with an edge line and eave, and this drawing has nothing like it.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate (bowling pins in a lane frame) has 13 visible tones per tile, which is within range of the hedge (9), stall (17) and well (20), and only 5% near-flat coverage, so density by the numbers is acceptable. The structure is the weak point. 98% of its dark edge pixels are near-neutral, so the outline is a black/grey line around the pieces. That is the sticker look, unlike the tinted dark-material outlines on the hedge (0%), the stall (1%) and the well (33%). The pins and the lane read as small white and grey blocks with about 3-4 lightness steps each. Beodeul materials use 5-6 steps, with per-element highlights and grain. The red stripe and the top sign are mostly flat bands. Texture is limited to a few dots on the pins. A careful artist would find it flatter and more outlined than the stall and well references.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate's tile density is fine: 13 visible tones per tile against 9-20 for the hedge, stall and well, and only 5% near-flat coverage. That gives the sticker look rather than the dark-material-tone edges of the hedge (0% neutral), the cheese stall (1%) and the well (33%). The lamp-crook is also 100% neutral, but it is thin iron, and the candidate's whites, greys and reds are not. The lane and backing show little grain or per-object shading, so the piece reads as clean but shallow. A careful artist would not accept it beside the references without tinted outlines and more ramp steps.
